data.one_liner: Dismisses the soft keyboard when tapping outside of a text field.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget wrapper that listens for taps outside text fields and automatically dismisses the software keyboard. It can be wrapped around the entire MaterialApp or specific individual widgets for localized control.
use_when: You want a global mechanism to close the keyboard on outside taps
You want a quick widget-based solution instead of managing FocusManagers manually
avoid_when: You need custom tap-handling behavior that conflicts with gesture detection on the root level
strengths: Very simple integration by wrapping MaterialApp or specific widgets
Works across multiple platforms including Android, iOS, web, and desktop
weaknesses: Limited configuration options documented beyond wrapping widgets
